gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-finlandica: Bruno Ace draws everything with a ruler's precision, one slow beat per character. Finlandica holds one quality above the rest: a constant-width outline you can follow with a finger, crossbars open-mouthed.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-gudea: Ruler-drawn lines of constant width give Bruno Ace its look, with counters that stay open to the outside and a lingering beat. Shrink the heading and Gudea, with glass-clear terminal gaps, quietly takes over.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-hanken-grotesk: Sharp and drawn by ruler: Bruno Ace holds every counter open to the outside, one lingering character at a time. But Hanken Grotesk does the quieter job, its wire-bent sans-serif strokes sending wide channels into each counter.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai: Strokes with no pinching at the curves make Bruno Ace look ruler-drawn, its counters staying connected to the outside. IBM Plex Sans Thai counters with c ends pointing apart like open pincers.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai-l: IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped leaves its curves refusing to close, a neutral, clean texture beneath Bruno Ace. And across a full page it reads gently, while Bruno Ace's unpinched curves stay out of its way.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-inclusive-sans: Distinctive from the first glance, Bruno Ace draws ruler-straight lines while its counters stay open to the outside. Inclusive Sans carries paragraphs with round letters whose rims match their stems, every curve left open-ended.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-jost: Expressive and ruler-drawn, Bruno Ace lets its counters stay open to the outside. Jost, the sans-serif beneath, keeps a unit-width stroke and broad terminal gaps, leaving the heading to earn its keep big and short.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-k2d: K2D has a tube-like thickness that holds through every bend, with c terminals hanging far from the bowl, beneath Bruno Ace. Bruno Ace's ruler-drawn lines then give the page its loud first word.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-kanchenjunga: Ruler-drawn lines and counters that stay open to the outside give Bruno Ace its display character. Kanchenjunga does the opposite job, drafting-pen steady and built so shapes never clog at low resolution.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-kodchasan: Clean below, distinctive above, and not at all alike. Bruno Ace does the showing off with ruler-drawn lines and counters open to the outside, while Kodchasan, with hanging terminals and no calligraphic thinning, keeps the text moving.
